summary: Prepare counters from pinned installed Rust components

delivery.outcome: Prepare scalar counters using one verified installed native Rust component directly, retain existing defaults and binary contracts, demonstrate shared loaded handle without exports, independently merge and clean owned checkout.
nonGoals: No algorithm/ABI/manifest schema/runtime dependency/platform change, consumer source migration, general arbitrary ABI loader, batch API expansion, hot reload, global deduplication or speed guarantee, download, registry release/deploy.

architecture.decision: Add optional rust_component descriptor and rust_library identity to prepare_ascii_token_counter for Rust-only installed donors. Reuse backend._rust_component audit and expose its verified absolute root only as private local snapshot result, excluded from provenance/fingerprint. Share scalar C ABI binder with existing SDK loader. Validate every preparation before reusing bounded16 cache by absolute library path/payload hash. Reuse existing callable/library retention and bytes semantics; default and compiled-python modes unchanged. Reject descriptor/ABI/symbol/ownership/drift failures before load; no import/export/copy/build. Test old fingerprint equality and real fresh runtime clients sharing installed path/handle/map with no toolchain/build deps. Keep immutable-install/process-cache/no-hot-reload contract explicit.
dataChanges: Private snapshot gains absolute root only; on-wire manifests and source digest inputs unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; default SDK counter and export/prebuilt flows remain. Preserve artifacts/ignored recovery and prior dist.

validation.evidence: Validate descriptor/identity/ownership/safe paths/drift, ABI/symbols and backend selection before load; retain input semantics/lifetime/defaults and old/new source fingerprints.

Full suites, actual installed native wheel in fresh no-build-dep/tool runtime, two clients share donor handle/path/mapping, no donor import/export, original bytes/reused NL8 and final artifacts. Canonicalv25/index/pinned Docs.
Exact-head gates/independent approval and merge, postmerge SDK/component smoke, current owner release and preserved exact cleanup.
